lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Coach

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I'll be participating in a skateboarding competition tomorrow.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Do you want to come?
Sorry, but I have plans.
I've got something important to take care of tomorrow.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Okay...

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I figured as much.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I guess

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I'll just have to take a rain check.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Besides, there will be more competitions in the future.
Wait

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Yeah?
Send me a video when you're done.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Sure.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: If you search for my name on Tetra Net

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: after the competition ends,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: you should be able to find videos my fans shot.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: But why?
Because I'm a fan of yours.
Wouldn't want to miss your spectacular moment!

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Since when?
Ever since I saw you skateboard for the first time.
Ever since you first hit the scene.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: No way...

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: You certainly never showed it! Haha

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Well, if that's how you feel,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: be sure to come to see me live next time.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: What are you on about? Haha

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I'm gonna have a spectacular lifetime, not just a moment!

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Anyway, be sure to come to see me live next time.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Although fans capture some awesome footage nowadays,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: it still can't compare to watching it live.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Also...

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: if you come to watch,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I feel like I'll be able to pull off even cooler tricks.
I'll make sure to be there next time.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: All right!

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: It's a deal then.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I've got this new trick that makes the crowd go wild,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: so I'm dying to show it to you live.
Can't wait to see it.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: All right,

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: I'm off to practice then.

lines.speaker: epinel
lines.text: Don't work too hard.
Sure thing.
... When the tasks are done tomorrow, let's search for Epinel on Tetra Net.
